description: This file defines a JSONStorage class that manages thread-safe JSON file operations including load, save, append, update, get_by_id, and filter functionalities, with logging support.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes JSONStorage with a cache path and creates directories if needed

methods.name: _get_file_path
methods.description: Constructs full file path for a given filename

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads data from a JSON file, returns list of dicts

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves data to a JSON file

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends an item to the JSON file with metadata

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing item in the JSON file by ID

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves an item by ID from the JSON file

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters items based on provided criteria
